blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY — A 54-year-old male employee of the Arayat municipal government died while a 10-year-old bystander was wounded in an early morning ambush at the town’s Gatiawin village on Wednesday. The municipal government employee was riding a motorcycle when a still unidentified assailant shot him several times at 7:20 a.m., the Pampanga police said. The gunman was on a motorcycle. The ambush wounded a 10-year-old boy, who was hit by a stray bullet. The boy is now recuperating at a hospital in Arayat.
